messages:
Ana (Partnerships): quick sync — Acme SI wants their marketplace listing to go live alongside our SOC2 attestation. They asked what evidence we can provide for listing (SOC2 docs, pen test summary, attestation letter) and whether firmware blobs from the HW partner can be redacted.
Isabel (HW Partner): we can redact firmware, but need a clear template for allowed redactions (hashes + metadata only). timeline: we can produce redacted artifacts in ~10 business days once we get the checklist.
Liam (Security): short answer: marketplaces usually accept a SOC2 type II report or a signed attestation + summary if the full report is sensitive. for pen tests we provide an executive summary + remediation statement. minimal artifact set we can offer: 1) SOC2 cover letter/attestation (signed PDF), 2) SOC2 summary (controls tested, period), 3) pen-test executive summary (findings + status), 4) contact for follow-ups.
Liam (Security): redaction rules: allow replacing firmware binaries with SHA256 and a small manifest (device model, build id, signing key id). do NOT remove cryptographic validation details. also provide proof of provenance (signed attestation from HW partner).
Jordan (Product): timing question — if SOC2 is expected week of Apr 12 (tentative), we should lock the announcement window to at least 2 weeks after final attestation to handle any last-minute clarifications. fallback: list as "compliance in progress" is possible but marketplace visibility is limited.
Ana (Partnerships): can security confirm pen-test window requirements? Acme SI asked for dates they can advertise to customers.
Liam (Security): pen-test scope: full external network + app stack for the hosted service; if HW partner wants a separate firmware review, that can be scoped as a separate engagement. estimated cadence: 1 week testing + 1 week remediation + final validation. give us preferred weeks and we'll coordinate.
Isabel (HW Partner): we'll aim to have redacted firmware manifests done within 7-10 business days once we get the checklist. please add any specific fields you need in the manifest.
Ana (Partnerships): OpsBot — please generate a presigned upload location and invite acme-si@partners.com + isabel@hwco.com for artifact ingestion.
OpsBot: presign created: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/presign/1791234567/upload (expires in 7 days). Recommended path: /partners/acme-si/1791234567/{artifact}. Please do not upload raw firmware blobs — upload a manifest + hash instead.
Isabel (HW Partner): got the link, thanks. who should we cc on the upload notification?
Liam (Security): cc: partnerships-evidence@redwood.com + security@redwood.com. i'll be the reviewer for pen-test exec summary.
Jordan (Product): note for launch planning — we need marketing copy that says "Validated: SOC2 attestation pending/confirmed" depending on final artifacts. Ana, can you draft two short blurbs for legal to sign off?
Ana (Partnerships): yes — i'll draft both and drop them here by EOD. thanks everyone — i'll follow up with the checklist and a slot request for the pen-test week.
